Vestigial_Canine_Flippers.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of a forgotten sea, these vestigial canine flippers are a haunting blend of piscine grace and lupine ferocity, granting their bearer an otherworldly swimming speed and the ability to dash through water with the silent precision of a predator.

Webbed_Pectoral_Canine_Fins.description: Emerging from the mutated form of ancient canine warriors, these webbed pectoral fins are a haunting blend of fur and slick, glistening membrane, granting unparalleled agility and maneuverability both on land and in water, enabling the wielder to execute acrobatic feats and glide through aquatic environments with supernatural grace.

Armored_Chitinous_Canine_Fins.description: Bristling with chitinous plates that interlock like ancient armor, these bizarre fins sprout from the flanks of a creature that is both canine and piscine, allowing it to swim with lethal grace while also granting it formidable defensive capabilities that make it a nightmare to face in combat.

Skeletal_Undead_Dog_Fins.description: Bony fins protrude from the skeletal dog's ribcage, a grotesque mutation that grants it the ability to glide silently through murky waters, its chilling presence draining the courage of any living creature that beholds it.

Bioluminescent_Angler_Canine_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of a shadowy, aquatic realm, the Bioluminescent Angler Canine Fins are a twisted mutation, with sleek, translucent fins that shimmer with an eerie glow, and sharp, canine-like teeth set within a snarling maw, their presence both captivating and terrifying as they navigate the dark waters with unnatural grace.

Spined_Toxic_Canine_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of a toxic swamp, the Spined Toxic Canine Fins are a grotesque mutation, with elongated canine limbs transformed into sinister fins bristling with sharp spines, capable of releasing a deadly poison cloud that engulfs foes in a miasma of toxins.

Cybernetic_Propulsion_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of a forgotten laboratory, the Cybernetic Propulsion Fins are a marvel of dark engineering, grafted onto the flanks of a canine form to grant it aquatic dominance, with sleek, mechanical fins that pulse with blue energy, enhancing its speed and granting it the Overdrive skill to sprint through water at terrifying velocities.

Sleek_Dolphin_Like_Canine_Fins.description: Bristling with sleek, dolphin-like fins sprouting from its forelegs and hindquarters, this mutant canine combines the grace of the sea with the ferocity of the land, its movements fluid and agile as it cuts through water with effortless aerobatic prowess.

Broad_Ray_Like_Canine_Fins.description: These broad, ray-like canine fins, a bizarre mutation of feline and aquatic biology, pulse with an otherworldly grace, enhancing the creature's balance and swimming prowess while granting it an innate ability to deflect attacks with a mere flick of its powerful, finned appendages.

Translucent_Ghostly_Canine_Fins.description: Emerging from the depths of the haunted sea, these ghostly canine fins shimmer with a faint, spectral glow, their ethereal form granting the bearer heightened wisdom and the uncanny ability to move unseen, while also bestowing the gift of seeing into the netherworlds.
